{{Quote|Beyond Tython, they settled first on Kalimahr, jewel of the Tython system, then Shikaakwa, the outlaw world, then on the forest planet Ska Gora, and on the moons of the Giants&mdash;Obri and Mawr&mdash;and even the outermost planet, cold Furies Gate.|[[Ketu]], of the non&ndash;Force-sensitive Tythans|<ref name="DotJ1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Obri''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that was located within the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region. Obri and [[Mawr]]&mdash;another gas giant of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]]&mdash;were collectively referred to by the settlers of the Tython system as "[[the Giants]]." More than thirty-six thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] colonized Obri's moons. By [[25,793 BBY]], gas-[[Mining/Legends|mining]] facilities had also been established within the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the planet itself.

==Description==
Obri was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located within the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region.<ref name="DotJ0" /> The planet occupied the ninth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around its [[Star/Legends|sun]], [[Tythos]], while three [[Moon/Legends|moons]]&mdash;<ref name="DotJ0" />including the cold, [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Zerist]]&mdash;<ref name="Eruption" />rotated around the planet in turn. Obri and [[Mawr]]&mdash;the tenth planet of the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] and also a gas giant&mdash;were collectively referred to by the settlers of the Tython system as "[[the Giants]]."<ref name="DotJ0" /> Myths and speculation led some to believe that monstrous and incorporeal claud creatures lived in the dense atmosphere of the gas giant, floating through the ether languorously.<ref name="Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|He owns interests in the mining operations on Obri's two other moons, but he's never been able to get a foothold with the Dessains.|[[Hawk Ryo]], on [[Volnos Ryo]]|<ref name="Eruption" />}}
When the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]&mdash;<ref name="DotJ1" />the fifth planet of the system&mdash;<ref name="DotJ0" />[[Second migration|traveled]] to its neighboring worlds more than a [[Time/Legends|millennium]] after<ref name="DotJ1" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,453 BBY]],<ref name="Into the Void" /> they colonized the moons of Obri.<ref name="DotJ0" /> By [[25,793 BBY]],<ref name="CBR">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cbr.com/nycc-exclusive-ostrander-and-duursema-unveil-star-wars-dawn-of-the-jedi|text=NYCC EXCLUSIVE: Ostrander and Duursema Unveil "Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi"|date=2011-10-13|archivedate=20200817183352|author=Manning, Shaun|quote=[..] the series really gets going with events just prior to the Force Wars, which began in 25,793 BBY.}}</ref> gas-[[Mining/Legends|mining]] facilities within the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] had also been established.<ref name="DotJ0" /> In that year,<ref name="CBR" /> [[Ketu]]&mdash;a [[Je'daii Temple Master|Temple Master]] of the mystic [[Je'daii Order]]&mdash;told the [[Padawan (Je'daii)|Padawan]] learners [[Harun]] and [[Resi]] the history of the Tython system, and mentioned the colonization of Obri's natural [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]], amid other events.<ref name="DotJ1" /> By that time, former followers of [[Hadiya]]&mdash;the deposed [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of the planet of [[Shikaakwa]]&mdash;were hiding on Obri's moons,<ref name="DotJ9">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 4]]</ref> on which mining operations had also been established by that time.<ref name="Eruption" />

==Behind the scenes==
Obri was first pictured in the entry for Tython in [[The Holonet]] feature of the official website for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''&mdash;a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. The gas giant was depicted in a schematic of the Tython system. Since its establishment in [[2008]], ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} website has gone through a number of changes, resulting in the removal of some of the features and images that were originally located there, including the aforementioned schematic. The Tython system&mdash;and therefore Obri&mdash;was placed in grid square L-10 by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''&mdash;a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], and published on [[August 18]], [[2009]]. Obri's name and additional information on it were provided in ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0]]'', a preview issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]]. The issue was published on [[February 1]], [[2012]] and was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]]. The planet was also mentioned in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|first]] and the [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 4|ninth]] issue of the series, which were published on [[February 15]] of year 2012 and [[March 27]] of year [[2013]], respectively. The short story ''[[Eruption]]'' takes place on Obri's moon Zerist; the story was was authored by Ostrander and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 141|one-hundred-forty-first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine.
